name: William Dick-Peddie

notes: Born Mar 1859 in Scotland to Scottish parents; married Alice B. McGroarty about 1886; in Emmetsburg Township in 1900 with Rose M. (13), Daisy J. C. (8), William S. (4) and John W. (2) (1900 census). The double surname Dick-Peddie is Scottish, best known from the Edinburgh architects.
